convergence.token_efficiency: Use one orchestration owner, a stable minimal worker policy, bounded immutable evidence packets and role-scoped tools. Preserve exact model routes, native cache accounting and failure receipts. This architecture avoids duplicated context and uncontrolled retries; this lane measures no counterfactual token reduction.
